user.title: Set up WoowTech Somfy Cover
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Somfy PoE Motor. You can find the Target ID and Encryption Key on the motor label or in the Somfy app.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check the IP address and ensure the motor is powered on and connected to the network.
error.invalid_target_id: Target ID must be a 6-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '160326').
error.invalid_key: Encryption key must be a 32-character hexadecimal string.

abort.already_configured: This device is already configured. Please remove the existing configuration before adding it again.
